activity_summary: You tied the parcel again and wrote three questions. Who stands by when a crown changes hands. What the old man is called before he is given words. Whether a comedy ends at the marriages or at the broken oaths. You wrote no line for anyone to speak.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Tied the parcel and left the questions as questions.
